feat(core+cli): S+12 — github-pr signal transport (v0.2b, ADR-0012)

Deliver a signal by opening a pull request against the peer's repo instead
of writing their working tree — the production transport ADR-0008 reserved.
The recipient merges under their own governance: delivery becomes a proposal
the receiver consents to, mirroring the protocol's own consent semantics.
With Tier 6 (recognize at a distance), the full discover → recognize →
deliver loop now runs with no shared filesystem.

Core (github-pr.ts):
- githubPrTransport drops in behind the v0.2a SignalTransport seam — no
  sender touched. Resolves did:web:github.com:owner:repo → target repo via a
  new shared githubRepoForDid (also reused by identity resolution).
- Fork-first (no push access to the peer's repo across an org boundary);
  direct branch only when push access exists.
- Deterministic branch flyway/inbox/<sanitized-from>/<id> is the idempotency
  key; an existing PR is a no-op. PR-open = delivered; acceptance is the
  recipient's merge, observed downstream by flyway_check, not awaited.
- gh-CLI auth behind an injectable RunGh — the whole flow is unit-tested with
  no network. gh missing/unauth/repo-unreachable/fork-blocked degrade to
  delivered:false with the outbox record intact.
- Shared renderInboxSignalFile keeps PR-delivered bytes byte-identical to
  local-fs (ADR-0008 invariant 3).

CLI: --transport github-pr on all four senders (tension/respond/propose/exit)
with a receipt-aware status line (offered <pr-url> vs delivered <path>).

CI: verify-signal GitHub Action (+ composite action) runs `flyway check` on
PRs touching flyway/inbox/**, comments the verdict, and gates the merge —
recognition runs in the recipient's own CI against their own cached keys.

Docs: ADR-0012 (Proposed), Tier 7 walkthrough (test-backed), status.md S+12.

+10 tests (427 total). ADR-0012 is Proposed, not yet Accepted.

feat(swaps): refundable on-chain swap fee + header account menu

Charge a 2 ADA platform fee when requesting a swap, refunded in full only if the other party declines. The fee is validated instantly by decoding the signed tx server-side - no waiting for on-chain confirmation - and refunds are auto-issued from a platform hot wallet on decline.

Fee flow:
- lib/cardano/fee.ts: client-safe fee config (amount, platform address, PAYMENTS_ENABLED). Blank platform address disables fees for local dev.
- lib/cardano/fee-client.ts: wallet builds+signs the fee tx (browser).
- lib/cardano/fee-verify.ts: signedTxPaysAtLeast() decodes the signed CBOR (Mesh CST) to verify the fee output synchronously at request time.
- lib/cardano/refund.ts: platform hot wallet (MeshWallet + Blockfrost) refunds a declined swap's fee.
- lib/cardano/providers.ts: verifyPaymentTx() re-checks the fee on-chain before any refund - the safety net for the optimistic confirm.
- POST /api/swaps: decode-verify, submit, store feeTxHash + CONFIRMED.
- PATCH /api/swaps/[id]: accept/cancel keep the fee (KEPT); decline auto-refunds (REFUNDED; deferred REFUND_PENDING retried on GET).
- Swap gains feeTxHash/feeLovelace/refundAddress/refundTxHash/paymentStatus (additive migration; prisma client regenerated).

UI:
- Fee notice + live status when requesting; fee/refund chip on the swap detail page; fee/refund status in the dashboard lists (Recent History now includes declined/cancelled so refunds are visible).
- Header avatar (mobile + desktop) is now an account menu (Profile / Log out); logout goes through a shared confirmation dialog, also used by the sidebar, mobile gains a logout path it lacked.

Verified end-to-end on preprod: fee paid, confirmed, and fully refunded on decline (each side pays only its own tx fee).

Requires NEXT_PUBLIC_PLATFORM_WALLET_ADDRESS, PLATFORM_WALLET_MNEMONIC and BLOCKFROST_API_KEY (see .env.example).

- proxy.ts: protect /messages, drop dead /discover
